rows.observation: 末句把「鬼魂会更安宁」译成「鬼魂的工作会更轻松」，明显改变原意；“within these walls”也被添译为「玻璃幕墙」。

rows.observation: tome-cults/data/lore/zones.lua:203 has 'I'm sure the spirits that haunt this place will rest easier knowing that there won't be any more victims'. Here 'rest easier' means the haunting spirits will be more at peace. The translation '鬼魂的工作，应该也会变得更轻松的吧' turns it into the ghosts' work getting easier, which inverts the meaning. It also softens 'I'm sure' into a guess. Separately, line 201 'no safety to be found within these walls' adds '玻璃幕墙', but the source only says walls; only the golems are made of glass.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults data/lore/zones.lua:201-203 城堡手记：the spirits that haunt this place will rest easier 是鬼魂更得安息，现译“鬼魂的工作……更轻松”意思颠倒，I'm sure 也被弱化为猜测；within these walls 只是墙壁，现译增出“玻璃幕墙”（只有傀儡是玻璃做的）。整句改写。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: unlock-demented_cultist_entropy.lua:30 'Rip apart spacetime to create rifts' is translated as '撕裂时间线'. Spacetime means 时空, not a timeline, so the class feature describes the wrong object.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults overload/data/texts/unlock-demented_cultist_entropy.lua:30 Rip apart spacetime to create rifts：spacetime 为时空而非时间线，rifts 按本职业技能树术语 rift=裂隙（terminology/talents.tsv）；现译“撕裂时间线，创造时间裂缝”，改“撕裂时空，创造裂隙”。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: fay-willows.lua:255 'if I remained within the Nargol city' is translated as '纳格尔王国'. That contradicts the source and the '纳格尔市场' earlier in the same entry: Nargol is a city here, not a kingdom. At line 253, 'When the guards finally moved in to clear them out' is translated as '搬进来清理', which misreads 'moved in' as relocating. The meaning is advancing to clear the area. At line 243, 'soon after the fires began to die down' is overstated as '完全熄灭了', and line 245 still says 'As the fires began to simmer', so the passage is now inconsistent.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults data/lore/fay-willows.lua:243-255：fires began to die down 现译“完全熄灭了”过度，且与下文 As the fires began to simmer 矛盾；remained within the Nargol city 现译“纳格尔王国”，与同条“纳格尔市场”不一；When the guards finally moved in to clear them out 现译“搬进来清理”误解 moved in。三处改：逐渐平息 / 纳格尔城 / 进场清理。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。
